summary: INX Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, disclosing its cumulative Adjusted Operating Cash Flow and the pro rata portion of the Distributable Amount per INX Token as of March 31, 2026. The filing notes that on November 10, 2025, the company was acquired by OpenDeal Inc. (d/b/a Republic), which triggered a cash distribution event under the INX Token purchase agreement. However, the acquisition is a past event, not the subject of this filing. The current disclosure relates to ongoing tokenholder distributions, not a new special situation.
